title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
@cursor Part 1 of 5 for issue #3: Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts, QA and bug fixes, Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #3, then do ONLY Part 1.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(recorder): add node id mirror (#3)` with tests and stubs, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Create the node id registry in `packages/recorder/src/mirror.ts` as described in Steps 1.

Requirements:
- Ids start at 1 and are never reused
- `WeakMap` for node to id
- Explain the id to node storage choice in the PR note

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- Tests: same node same id, removed node id not reused, getNode after remove

Implementation commit message: `feat(recorder): add node id mirror (#3)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" ...`.

If you make a decision a reviewer might question, add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and list it in docs/decisions/README.md.
